newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle markets quiet, no bids - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle markets quiet, no bids - private.

text.p: Nebraska cattle were quiet early Friday, with no bids reported, feedlot sources said.
Sources said meat packers appeared to have enough cattle for immediate requirements and were content to await the USDA Cattle-On-Feed report due at 1400 CDT/2000GMT.
Analysts expect the report to show active October placements, with estimates averaging 105.7 percent of a year ago.
Next week's showlist was estimated at 90,000 head, which is about unchanged from this week. Also, sources said about 30 percent of next week's list was carried over from this week.
However, with cattle being marketed ahead of schedule in recent weeks, feedlot sources said this week's unsold cattle could use more days in feedlots.
